metadata.case_name: HO PING SHUI v. GREAT WALL HOUSE WARE MANUFACTORY

plaintiff.occupation_after: driver's mate (delivery truck) with Kowloon Dairy

injuries.description: right hand crushed in power press with parts of three fingers amputated
source: In the course of such employment plaintiff's right hand was trapped and crushed in a power press. Farts of three fingers were later amputated.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of two or more fingers at or near base, right hand

injuries.description: amputation of ring finger at the upper joint
source: The doctor described in evidence an amputation the same day of plaintiff's ring finger at the upper joint and an attempt to recreate the blood supply to the other two injured fingers by suturing together the damaged blood vessels.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

injuries.description: amputation of index finger at the lower joint
source: This treatment failed to save the index finger, which was amputated at the lower joint on 3rd February 1983.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

injuries.description: middle finger bone and tissue damage with parts removed and remainder fused leaving the finger in a permanent 180 degree position
source: the middle finger suffered bone damage and both bone and tissue were cut back to allow fusion of the middle section of the finger to both its upper and lower sections.
parts of all three sections of the middle finger were removed and the remainder fused together leaving the finger in a permanent 180 degree position.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

manifestations.description: considerable pain in the early stages of his recovery
some tenderness due to the fingers remaining sensitive after amputation
permanent 180 degree position of the middle finger
50 pound grip strength with his injured right hand as opposed to a 100 pound grip strength with his left hand
writing severely affected, being childlike and taking over twice the average time to complete a given passage

treatments_received: amputation of ring finger at the upper joint
attempt to recreate blood supply to other injured fingers by suturing damaged blood vessels
amputation of index finger at the lower joint
reconstruction of middle finger by micro-surgery with parts removed and remainder fused
regular dressings at South Kwai Chung Clinic
physiotherapy twice a week until mid-August

losses.description: considerable cosmetic disability will be a permanent effect of the injuries and relate that also to the plaintiff's awareness of feelings of distaste which his visible deformity will inevitably arouse in others.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: diminished recreational life, in particular as to his hobbies of ten-pin bowling and playing the guitar.
diminished marriage prospects; Plaintiff himself spoke of his broken relationship with his girl friend, and of her parents' reservations as to his ability to support her after the accident.
parts of all three sections of the middle finger were removed and the remainder fused together leaving the finger in a permanent 180 degree position.

comparable_cases.injury_description: similar as to both the injuries and the age of the plaintiff. The injuries and consequent impairment were slightly more serious, but the hospital treatment was considerably less.
similar injuries and treatment (judge regarded this decision as out of line)
